subject: Quarter ignition: exec briefboard, OKR alignment & QBR checklist
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: strategy-consultant@kestreladvisors.com
Date: 2027-04-12 09:02 -0700
Subject: Quarter ignition: exec briefboard, OKR alignment & QBR checklist

Team — attaching the draft briefboard and the OKR tracker for the quarter ignition. Goal here is to lock owners and gating metrics by end of EOD Tuesday so the product and GTM teams can start their deep-plans next week.

Key asks:
- Review tab "Owners + Gates" in OKR_tracker_Q2.csv and confirm owner allocations (highlighted cells).
- Tighten metric definitions (I flagged 3 metrics that need a clearer SLA).
- Confirm QBR narrative owners (slides 2-5 in deck).

Tentative timeline:
- Today: exec read + comments
- Tue 4/13 AM: final edits + sign-off
- Tue 4/13 PM: publish to Circulate + Ops kickoff

Attachments: QBR_prep_deck_v2.pdf, OKR_tracker_Q2.csv, exec-brief-appendix.docx

Thanks — I tried to keep the briefboard under 12 slides and the tracker lean. If you want a 30-min alignment before the sign-off window tomorrow, say the word and I’ll lock a room.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategy, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12 10:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter ignition: exec briefboard, OKR alignment & QBR checklist

Hannah — thanks for pulling this together. Quick read and a few notes inline (see comments in the Drive link):
- Owners: I can take the "Latency economics" metric but recommend we split it into P50/P95 for clarity.
- Slide 3 (go-to-market): can we add a one-liner about Dedicated capacity upsell motion? It's a gating narrative for the QBR.
- Appendix: procurement timeline is fine, but we need a path for SLA exceptions (I added a short paragraph in exec-brief-appendix.docx).

I’ll update the tracker and push a revised CSV to the Drive by 3pm today. No blocking asks on the deck; agree with your timeline.

-Kimberly
Director, GTM Strategy
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12 12:40 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter ignition: exec briefboard, OKR alignment & QBR checklist

Thanks Hannah / Kim — good deck. Two asks before I can sign off:
1) Product adoption metric: please add a short definition so reviewers don't conflate MAU-style metrics with usage-per-customer. Suggest: "active customers with >2 API endpoints and >1000 tokens/day for 14 consecutive days".
2) QBR rehearsal: recommend a 45-min dry run on Tue 4/13 10:00am (PDT) to walk through transitions between slides 2-6. Marcus — can you confirm availability for that slot?

Minor edits: slide footer should include the quarter and updated date (I left a comment).

Lauren
VP Product Operations

Date: 2027-04-13 08:25 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter ignition: exec briefboard, OKR alignment & QBR checklist

Morning — I’m good with the additions. Confirming a few operational points:
- 4/13 10:00am dry run works for me. I’ll own slide transitions for "Serving & Runtime" and take the quantization recommendation callout.
- OKR tracker: I merged Kim’s edits and normalized the metric column (see Drive).
- Risk callout: we should add a short fallback plan slide if a key upstream integration slips. I drafted language in the appendix (attached).

I approve for exec read; final sign-off pending Vivek.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Serving Runtime

Date: 2027-04-13 17:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter ignition: exec briefboard, OKR alignment & QBR checklist

Thanks everyone — I read the revised deck and tracker this afternoon (great work getting it tight). A few final notes and sign-off: 
- Sign-off: Approved for exec circulation. Please update the deck footer to include "Approved by Exec — 4/13/27".
- KPIs: adopt Lauren’s adoption definition and Kim’s P50/P95 split for latency.
- QBR rehearsal: run the 45-min dry run Tue 4/13 10:00am; Marcus lead transitions.
- Ops: Hannah — please publish the final files to the Drive and ping Growth/CS to ensure pre-read distribution.

One ask for future cadence: let’s add a short pre-mortem section in the appendix for any high-risk OKRs (helps the exec committee focus).

Approved — Vivek
COO, Redwood Inference
